item.title: Kiyomizu Temple, Kumamoto — Guide
item.description: Kiyomizu Temple in Kumamoto is a peaceful Buddhist temple offering a tranquil retreat from the busier city sights. Set among greenery, its weathered wooden halls, mossy stone steps, statues and quiet grounds create a serene, contemplative atmosphere that changes gently with the seasons — cherry or plum blossom in spring, fresh green in summer, and coloured leaves in autumn. Away from the tourist crowds of the castle, it’s the kind of local temple where you can slow down, stroll the grounds, offer a prayer, and enjoy the timeless calm of a working place of worship.
